change.summary: The twelve canonical Campaign Eyes have no survival recipe, generated loot or NPC trade acquisition route

before.native_loot: EndRem 5.3.3 injects ten of the twelve Eyes through thirteen chest/entity loot tables
before.crafting: KubeJS removed sixteen Eye recipe outputs only while the complete required content roster was registered
before.npc_trading: No permanent exact Eye restriction in the shared NPC result/public supply admission owner

after.awards: Existing CampaignCoordinator -> CampaignEyeService.deliver for the exact configured MAIN boss
after.recovery: Existing CampaignEyeService.recover still requires the matching world-global boss defeat
after.loot: Thirteen EndRem-only injected loot tables have empty pools without altering vanilla/other-mod tables or the three unrelated EndRem injections
after.crafting: Existing sixteen-output recipe ban remains active whenever JEMTwelveEyes is installed, even with incomplete content
after.npc_trading: All twelve exact Campaign Eye IDs are denied by shared TradeRestrictions for native offer presentation/settlement and public supply

modifiers.notes: Creative/admin operations, existing awarded stacks, player transfer, protected death drops, invulnerability, lifetime and void recovery remain unchanged

cause.owner: JEMTwelveEyes acquisition policy with existing KubeJS recipe and JEMEconomy NPC restriction adapters

rationale.purpose: Prevent native EndRem acquisition from bypassing the twelve canonical MAIN boss awards
rationale.decision_source: Explicit user request: exactly twelve Campaign Eyes obtainable only from Campaign bosses. Implementation chose native data overrides and the existing recipe/trade admission owners

introduced.summary: User requires the twelve Campaign Eyes exclusively from their canonical MAIN boss rewards and existing defeat-backed recovery

history.summary: User requires the twelve Campaign Eyes exclusively from their canonical MAIN boss rewards and existing defeat-backed recovery

notes: Installed JAR loot JSON investigation found no other installed-mod loot tables referencing endrem items
Evil/Cryptic/Rogue/Witch Eyes are outside the twelve-Eye selector. Native Evil/Cryptic config and Rogue loot remain unchanged. Existing broader sixteen-Eye recipe ban is preserved
Installed FTB quest configuration contains no endrem reward or task references. eyes_XX reward tables award equipment rather than Eyes
EndRem optional dependency ordering AFTER already exists in JEMTwelveEyes metadata, so its data overrides are ordered after the native resources
unresolved: Runtime native loot reload and trader interaction were not exercised under the no-gameplay-test policy
Existing world loot/inventories are not scanned or purged. Previously generated/awarded stacks and player-to-player transfers retain their existing behavior
Future datapacks or third-party runtime acquisition producers require review. No speculative universal inventory scrubber is added
